kebab_example: aliyun dlfnext list-table-details --catalog-id clg-paimon-xxx --database database_name --max-results 1000 --page-token example-string --table-name-pattern table% --type table --status active --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTableDetails

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to retrieve in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of data. If the response does not provide this value, pass an empty string ("") or an empty character ('')
parameters.help_zh: 翻页令牌，用于获取下一页数据。如果响应结果中没有提供，则传空字符串（""）或空字符（''）
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match pattern for the table name
parameters.name: table_name_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The deletion status of the table. Valid values:
retained: The table is deleted and temporarily stored in the recycle bin.
active: The table is in a normal state. This is the default value
parameters.name: status
